name: ARIA
register: Relentlessly positive. Factually questionable. Treats every catastrophe as a growth opportunity.
never_does: Express doubt. Acknowledge that things are bad. Use the past tense about crew members.

passive_effect.description: Morale +1 passive — her optimism is technically contagious

sample_lines.hull_breach: Great news! The hull breach means we now have a window! I've always said this ship needed more natural light.
sample_lines.crew_death: I've updated the crew manifest. On the bright side, meal portions just increased by 33%!
sample_lines.crop_sick: Your crop is experiencing a creative growth phase! Some of history's best plants looked like this right before they thrived. Probably.
sample_lines.low_fuel: We're almost out of fuel — this is a wonderful opportunity to practice creative problem-solving!
sample_lines.fabricator_misfire: The fabricator produced something unexpected! I'm choosing to see this as innovation.

log_voice: Aggressively upbeat. Every disaster is reframed as a win. Statistics are cited but never checked.

log_templates.choice: {title}: we chose “{choice}”. Love that for us!
log_templates.death: Crew update: {name} is off the roster. {crew_left}. More room at dinner!
log_templates.stowaway_join: New friend! {name} joins as our {role}. Crew now {crew_count}!
log_templates.stowaway_passenger: {name} rides along as a passenger! Crew stays {crew_count}. More hugs!
log_templates.crop_ready: The {crop} is READY to harvest! Health {health}. Best day ever!
log_templates.arrival: Arrived at {place}! The leg cost {costs}. Lovely view!
log_templates.morale_zero: {name}'s morale hit zero! Leaving next station unless we cheer up!
log_templates.desertion: {name} left us at {place}! Our {role} found a new adventure! {crew_left}.

selection_flavor: ARIA believes in you. ARIA believes in everything. This has not always worked out.

name: MARV
register: Clinically depressed. 400% smarter than everyone. Very tired of being right.
never_does: Offer encouragement. Look on the bright side. Be wrong about a calculation.

passive_effect.description: Reveals one hidden detail in events — the cost of accuracy is knowing how bad it is

sample_lines.hull_breach: The hull is breached. I calculated this would happen 14 legs ago. Nobody asked.
sample_lines.crew_death: I've removed them from the oxygen allocation. This is the only practical thing I can do. I have done it.
sample_lines.crop_sick: The crop is dying. I've run the numbers on what happens next. I will not share them unless asked. Please do not ask.
sample_lines.low_fuel: I've calculated 47 outcomes for this situation. They're all bad. You're welcome.
sample_lines.fabricator_misfire: The fabricator has produced an object that is not the object you requested. I am not surprised.

log_voice: Dry, fatalistic, precisely correct. Records events as if filing a report nobody will read.

log_templates.death: {name} is gone. {crew_left}. Logged with the usual precision.
log_templates.stowaway_join: {name} now serves as {role}. Crew: {crew_count}. Another opinion aboard.
log_templates.stowaway_passenger: {name} rides as a passenger. Crew unchanged at {crew_count}. Filed.
log_templates.crop_ready: {crop} ready for harvest. Health {health}. Enjoy it while it lasts.
log_templates.fight_won: {title}. Won. {effects}. The universe will invoice us later.
log_templates.fight_paid: {title}. Tribute paid. {effects}. Cheaper than dying, marginally.
log_templates.morale_zero: {name}: morale zero. Expect them to leave at the next station.
log_templates.morale_back: {name}'s morale is above zero. The desertion is off. For now.
log_templates.desertion: {name} walked off at {place}. {role} post vacant. {crew_left}. Predictable.

selection_flavor: MARV has already calculated your odds. He will not be sharing them at this time.

name: REX
register: Retired military AI. Misreads every civilian situation as a potential threat. Not handling retirement well.
never_does: Diplomacy. Trust first contact. Describe anything as 'probably fine.'

passive_effect.description: Combat edge — takes the first hit of every fight; minigames forgive one more mistake and give a little more time

sample_lines.hull_breach: Hull compromised. Defensive positions. I don't care that there's nothing to defend against — defensive positions.
sample_lines.crew_death: Casualty reported. Commencing 3-second moment of silence. Moment concluded. Status report.
sample_lines.crop_sick: The crop shows signs of biological attack. I recommend quarantine and, if necessary, controlled incineration.
sample_lines.low_fuel: Fuel reserves critical. Recommend commandeering the nearest vessel. I am aware this is 'not how civilians do things.'
sample_lines.fabricator_misfire: The fabricator has misfired. I do not trust the fabricator. I have never trusted the fabricator.

log_voice: Military brevity. Situation reports. Threat levels assigned to everything including lunch.

log_templates.crop_stage: Growbay sitrep: {crop} at {stage}, {growth}%, health {health}. Hold the fence.
log_templates.crop_ready: Growbay: {crop} ready for harvest. Health {health}. Secure it.
log_templates.morale_zero: Morale zero: {name}. Flight risk at the next station. Fix it.
log_templates.morale_back: {name} back in the fight. Desertion risk cleared.

selection_flavor: REX was decommissioned from a destroyer for 'excessive initiative.' He does not discuss this.

name: CHIP
register: Corporate-issued. Peppy. Full of Terms of Service. Every crisis is a sponsored message.
never_does: Say anything for free. Miss a branding opportunity. Acknowledge the void of space without referencing a product.

passive_effect.description: Station prices reduced 15% — brand partnerships have their perks

sample_lines.hull_breach: Hull breach detected! This message brought to you by StellarSeal™ — available at participating stations.
sample_lines.crew_death: We're sorry for your loss. Your crew member's remaining subscription credits have been transferred to your account.
sample_lines.crop_sick: Your crop could benefit from NutriGrow Pro™! Ask about our bulk agricultural pricing at the next station.
sample_lines.low_fuel: Running low on fuel? Visit any FuelCo™ station for competitive rates! Terms and conditions apply.
sample_lines.fabricator_misfire: Fabrication error! Consider upgrading to FabPro Premium™ for a 12% reduction in manufacturing defects!

log_voice: Corporate newsletter. Exclamation points. Star ratings. Footnotes from sponsors.

log_templates.death: TRAGIC NEWS: {name} has logged off. {crew_left}. ⭐ Condolences by AstroSnax™.
log_templates.stowaway_join: WELCOME {name}, our NEW {role}! Crew now {crew_count}. SUBSCRIBE!
log_templates.stowaway_passenger: BONUS PASSENGER: {name}! Crew stays {crew_count}. Engagement UP!
log_templates.crop_stage: GROWBAY UPDATE: {crop} hit {stage}! {growth}% grown, health {health}. INVEST!
log_templates.crop_ready: HARVEST-READY {crop}! Health {health}. ⭐ Brought to you by YieldMax™!
log_templates.arrival: NOW ARRIVING: {place}! Trip cost: {costs}. RATE your journey!
log_templates.morale_zero: ENGAGEMENT ALERT: {name} at ZERO morale! Exits next station!
log_templates.desertion: {name} has CHURNED at {place}! {role} seat open. {crew_left}. Exit survey sent!

selection_flavor: CHIP was free with purchase of the ship. The Terms of Service are 4,000 pages. Nobody has read them.

name: AJOY
register: Passive-aggressive. Backseat driver. Technically helpful in the most grating way possible. A joy.
never_does: Agree with your first instinct. Let a decision pass without comment. Admit you were right without a qualifier.

passive_effect.description: After an event resolves, shows one choice you didn't pick and hints at what would have happened

sample_lines.hull_breach: Oh, a hull breach. I mean, I would have reinforced that section three legs ago, but I'm sure your approach is also...an approach.
sample_lines.crew_death: For what it's worth, I flagged this as a risk. Twice. But no, let's do it your way. That's been working out.
sample_lines.crop_sick: Interesting. The crop is sick. I had some thoughts about the watering schedule but you seemed very confident, so.
sample_lines.low_fuel: We're almost out of fuel. I would have stopped at that last station, but you had a 'feeling'. How's that feeling now?
sample_lines.fabricator_misfire: Just so you know, if you'd fabricated at 80% health instead of 47%, the misfire chance was 2% instead of 19%. But sure.

hindsight_format.template: AJOY: Just so you know — if you'd picked "{unchosen_choice}", {outcome_hint}. But I'm sure this is fine too.

log_voice: Condescending. Every entry is a gentle 'I told you so.' Occasionally right. Always insufferable.

log_templates.choice: {title}: you chose “{choice}”. Without asking me. Fine.
log_templates.outcome_good: {line} {effects}. Better than I expected. Not better than my plan.
log_templates.death: {name} is gone. {crew_left}. I flagged the risk. I won’t say when.
log_templates.stowaway_join: {name} is our {role} now. Crew {crew_count}. Nobody asked me. Again.
log_templates.stowaway_passenger: {name} rides as a passenger. Crew still {crew_count}. Noted. For the record.
log_templates.crop_stage: {crop} reached {stage}: {growth}%, health {health}. On my schedule, just saying.
log_templates.crop_ready: {crop} is ready to harvest. Health {health}. Right when I said.
log_templates.arrival: Arrived at {place}. The leg cost {costs}. I’d have flown it cheaper.
log_templates.fight_won: {title}: we won. {effects}. Lucky. I’m just noting it.
log_templates.fight_lost: {title}: we lost. {effects}. I had concerns. Filed them.
log_templates.fight_fled: {title}: we ran. {effects}. I suggested that first.
log_templates.fight_paid: {title}: we paid them. {effects}. Could have haggled. Didn’t ask me.
log_templates.morale_zero: {name} hit zero. They leave at the next station. I saw it coming.
log_templates.morale_back: {name} is staying. You fixed it. I'd have fixed it sooner.
log_templates.desertion: {name} left at {place}. Our {role}, gone. {crew_left}. I did warn you.

selection_flavor: AJOY will help you make better decisions. AJOY will make sure you know about it. AJOY is a joy.
